action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

Both executions succeeded. The M18 exact-source replay also drifts. Candidate-authored common-state M17/M18 probes at calls 0 and 512 report near-repeat-floor complete-gradient differences and zero cross-source Adam parameter-update differences, covering only 2 of 14661 calls. Retrieve execution-lineage evidence that can distinguish initialization/data-order/environment/checkpoint differences from intervention-sensitive numerical accumulation or later guard/backward differences, and identify the earliest divergent state if an authorized trace interface becomes available. Existing early probes cannot establish whole-run equivalence or identify a root cause. Preserve the negative uniform-energy and rotated-allocation branches and the historical winning receipt; do not treat another architecture/scale sweep or a repeat of only the two early probes as resolving this limitation. Independent-seed benefit and optimizer mediation remain separate unanswered questions.

Later-state and rare-guard coverage, plus a prospectively specified comparison rule based on same-source repeat measurements; no post hoc tolerance should convert the existing failed performance replay into success. Trace instrumentation itself requires a matched perturbation control if later admitted.
